card.fact_statement: The Sabin Vaccine Institute delivered trial vaccines during the 2024 Rwanda Marburg virus disease outbreak.
card.source_span: These trial vaccines were delivered by the Sabin Vaccine Institute as a support by the government of US and international partners.
